props.gloss_en: R' Yochanan: a 'city of gold' is a golden Jerusalem
...like the one R' Akiva made for his wife
a woman may not go out with a city of gold
R' Meir: and if she went out, she is liable to a sin-offering
Chachamim: she may not go out, and if she went out she is exempt
R' Eliezer: a woman may go out with a city of gold ab initio
R' Meir holds it is a burden
the Rabbis hold it is an ornament
the Rabbis: [it is forbidden] lest she take it off and show it, and come to carry it
R' Eliezer: whose way is it to go out with a city of gold? an important woman -- and an important woman does not take off and show
Rav forbids [going out with] a kelila
[going out with] a kelila is permitted
of metal, everyone agrees it is forbidden
where they dispute is a woven kelila
one master holds the metal is primary
and the other master holds the weave is primary
Rav Ashi teaches it leniently: of weave, everyone agrees it is permitted
where they dispute is a metal kelila
one master holds [it is forbidden] lest she take it off and show it, and come to carry it
the other master holds: whose way is it to go out with a kelila? an important woman -- and an important woman does not take off and show
Rav: who is a great tall man who limps? Levi
Rav: conclude that R' Afes has died and R' Chanina sits at the head, and Levi had no one to sit with, and so he has come here
Rebbi, when dying: Chanina son of R' Chama sits at the head
and of the righteous it is written: 'you shall decree a thing and it shall be established for you' (Job 22:28)
R' Chanina could not have failed to reign
twenty-four kelilot went out of all Nehardea
and eighteen kelilot went out of one alley [in Mechoza]
[going out with] a kamra is permitted
some say: [the kamra permitted was one] of weave
and Rav Safra said: just as with a gilded cloak
and some say: [the kamra permitted was one] of metal
and Rav Safra said: just as with the belt of kings
Ravina: a kamra over a belt -- what [is its law]?
Rav Ashi: you are speaking of two belts
Rav Ashi: a resoka, if it has straps -- permitted
...and if not -- forbidden

מידי דהוה אטלית מוזהבת -- a woven kamra is like a gilded cloak
מידי דהוה אאבנט של מלכים -- a metal kamra is like the belt of kings

objections.gloss_en: ודילמא נח נפשיה דרבי חנינא, ורבי אפס כדקאי קאי, ולא הוה ליה איניש ללוי למיתב גביה וקאתי להכא? -- perhaps it was R' Chanina who died, and Levi, left without a companion, came here

answered_by.gloss_en: אם איתא דרבי חנינא שכיב -- לוי לרבי אפס מיכף הוה כייף ליה: had R' Chanina died, Levi would have submitted to R' Afes
ותו, דרבי חנינא לא סגי דלא מליך -- R' Chanina had to reign, by Rebbi's deathbed word and Job 22:28 (= p_r_chanina_lo_sagi_dlo_malich)
